title: Soil: More Than Dirt
objective: After this level you can describe what soil is made of and name the layers you would see in a soil pit.
summary: Healthy soil is about 45% minerals, 25% water, 25% air and 5% organic matter. Five factors shape it, and a soil pit shows layers from O at the top to bedrock at the bottom.

cards.headline: Half of a handful of healthy soil is empty space.
cards.body: Well, not empty: those gaps hold water and air. Soil isn't just crushed rock. It's a recipe, built up in layers, and every layer tells you something.

cards.fact: A typical healthy soil is about 45% minerals, 25% water, 25% air and 5% organic matter.
cards.context: The minerals are tiny rock fragments, sorted by size into sand, silt and clay; a clay particle needs a powerful microscope to see. The organic matter is the decaying remains of once-living things. Rock, water, air and life: Level 1's four spheres in one handful.

cards.headline: Five ingredients, one soil
cards.body: Soil develops as its parent material, the rock or deposit underneath, weathers. Four more factors shape it: climate, living things, topography (the lay of the land) and time. Where all five match, the soil matches. Change any one, and you get a different soil.

cards.headline: Dig a soil pit
cards.body: Dig down and you'll see layers called horizons. O on top is mostly decaying leaves. A is topsoil: minerals mixed with organic matter, a good home for plants. E, missing in some soils, has been washed out. B, the subsoil, collects minerals leached from above. C is the parent material. Below it lies R: bedrock such as granite, basalt, limestone or sandstone. Bedrock isn't soil.
cards.callout: O · A · E · B · C · R

cards.headline: Soil: dug up
learned: Soil is minerals, water, air and organic matter
Horizons run O, A, E, B, C

questions.prompt: In a soil pit, which horizon is the topsoil?

options.label: O
options.rationale: O is mostly decaying leaves, above the topsoil.

options.label: R
options.rationale: R is bedrock, which isn't soil.

questions.explanation: The A horizon is topsoil: minerals mixed with organic matter.

questions.prompt: Soil looks solid. What fills about half of a typical healthy soil?

options.label: Clay particles
options.rationale: Clay is part of the mineral share.

questions.explanation: About 25% water plus about 25% air: half of a healthy soil is pore space.

questions.prompt: A soil pit ends at dark, very fine-grained bedrock that formed from lava. Using Level 5, which rock is its R horizon?

options.label: Granite
options.rationale: Granite is coarse and cools underground.

options.label: Limestone
options.rationale: Limestone comes from shells, not lava.

questions.explanation: Basalt is the dark, fine-grained rock of fast-cooled lava, and it's one of the bedrocks an R horizon can be.
